subject: Request: Temporary quarterly billing + conditional Net-90 approval (Heliotrope pilot)
body:
From: Aisha Moreno <aisha.moreno@heliotrope.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@heliotrope.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing request — quarterly invoices + Net-90 ask

Hi Soojin,

Great demo yesterday — thanks for walking the ops team through the runtime. We are excited to run a small Q3 pilot (3 months) with Redwood. To align with our internal forecasting, Finance has asked whether we can receive quarterly invoices instead of monthly and whether we could be on Net-90 for the pilot period.

Proposed structure:
- Quarterly invoice covering the quarter (estimated $95k).
- Net-90 payment terms for the pilot.
- Redwood can invoice at quarter close; Heliotrope will remit within 90 days.

If needed we can pre-authorize the first quarter via an ACH hold or run a credit card for the first invoice. Please let me know if Redwood has any standard guardrails for pilot Net-90 or additional paperwork.

Thanks,
Aisha Moreno
Head of Integrations, Heliotrope Health
finance@heliotrope.com

--
Attachment: Heliotrope_Scheduling_Table.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

---

On Wed, 10 Mar 2027 at 10:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Aisha Moreno <aisha.moreno@heliotrope.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 10, 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing request — quarterly invoices + Net-90 ask

Hi Aisha — really appreciate the clear ask and the budget visibility.

Quick notes: we can invoice quarterly for the pilot; Net-90 is non-standard for pilots and requires an exec/finance signoff, plus additional safeguards on our side. Two paths that would make this approvable from our side:
1) Conditional Net-90 with 25% due within 14 days as a goodwill deposit (applied to the quarter), OR
2) Net-90 plus a signed LOI that includes guaranteed funds language (e.g., ACH authorization or escrow).

I'll escalate to finance and Revenue Ops for approval. Can you confirm whether Heliotrope can do a 25% deposit by ACH if needed? If not, we will need the LOI route.

I am copying Jonas and Marcus for visibility and Naomi from finance to review.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec ask: temporary quarterly invoice cadence + conditional Net-90 for Heliotrope pilot (Deal HLT-2027-0038)

Jonas/Marcus —

Requesting quick exec approval for a temporary billing cadence change for a strategic pilot with Heliotrope (Healthcare vertical). Details:
- Pilot length: Q3 (3 months), estimated contract value ~$95k for the quarter.
- Customer asks: quarterly invoices + Net-90 for the pilot term.
- Risk mitigation proposed: 25% deposit due within 14 days of invoice (applied to invoice) OR signed LOI with ACH authorization. If neither is possible, ask is to require a credit card on file and limit Net-90 to a single quarter only (no renewal without standard terms).

Why consider: Heliotrope is an important reference in healthcare and could lead to a full enterprise rollout if pilot metrics meet SLOs. Losing the pilot over rigid invoice cadence risks delaying the opportunity.

Financial ask: allow temporary Net-90 for Q3 pilot, conditional on (choose one): deposit OR LOI with guaranteed funds clause. Naomi, please flag any immediate compliance or cashflow concerns.

Thanks — would appreciate a reply today so I can respond to Aisha.

Soojin

---

On Thu, 11 Mar 2027 at 11:12 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Mar 11, 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec ask: temporary quarterly invoice cadence + conditional Net-90 for Heliotrope pilot (Deal HLT-2027-0038)

Soojin —

Finance is comfortable with a CONDITIONAL Net-90 for a single quarter pilot if we get one of the following safeguards:
- 25% deposit (ACH) OR
- Signed LOI with explicit payment authorization/ACH/escrow OR
- Company credit card on file that covers at least the first invoice date + 30 days.

Additionally: mark the customer record in billing with ‘pilot Net-90 — contingent’ and require signoff from Billing Ops before invoicing. Limit the approval to Q3 pilot only; no legacy change to standard T&Cs.

If Aisha confirms ACH deposit, we can proceed without exec signatures. If they want pure Net-90 with no deposit/LOI/CC, we need Marcus/Jonas signoff to accept the incremental cashflow risk.

Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec ask: temporary quarterly invoice cadence + conditional Net-90 for Heliotrope pilot (Deal HLT-2027-0038)

Agree with Naomi — approve conditional Net-90 for the Q3 pilot only IF one of the safeguards is in place. If Heliotrope can do a 25% ACH deposit, accept quarterly invoices + Net-90 for the pilot.

If they cannot provide deposit/LOI/CC we should push back and offer a compromise: allow quarterly invoice but keep Net-30 with a 15% discount applied to first quarter as concession. That keeps cashflow intact while showing flexibility.

Marking approved by Revenue for conditional path. Jonas — please ensure Billing Ops has the correct flag.

Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Moreno <aisha.moreno@heliotrope.com>, Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@heliotrope.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot billing request — quarterly invoices + Net-90 ask

Hi Aisha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Good news: we can support quarterly invoices for the Q3 pilot and approve Net-90 on a conditional basis. Please choose one of the following so we can finalize:

Option A — Preferred (fastest): 25% deposit of the first-quarter invoice by ACH within 14 days of invoice issue (applied to that invoice).

Option B — LOI: Sign a short LOI that includes ACH authorization/guaranteed funds language for the pilot quarter. We will scaffold the LOI and share it for signature.

Option C — If neither A nor B are possible: Redwood will invoice quarterly but require Net-30, and we will apply a 15% one-time concession to the first-quarter invoice.

Attachment: Heliotrope_SOW_Q3.pdf (pdf, 145KB) — SOW and pilot scope for reference. We can send a DocuSign link for the LOI if you prefer.

Please confirm which option you prefer and whether Heliotrope can do an ACH deposit. Once you confirm, Billing Ops (copied) will proceed with the invoice flagging.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Soojin — thank you and the team for the flexibility. We will go with Option B (LOI + ACH authorization). Carlos and I will review the LOI you draft and revert. I will also copy our procurement attorney for a quick review. Looking forward to the SOW and DocuSign link.

Aisha
